methodologyNotes: Covers standalone PC case/chassis cooling fans sold at retail with a published US MSRP, in the common 120mm and 140mm frame sizes (other frame sizes such as 92mm or 200mm are permitted when notable). Excludes CPU-cooler-bundled fans not sold separately, laptop blowers, and PSU fans. Price is typical US MSRP in USD for a single fan (priceNote states if the SKU is only sold in a multi-pack). fanSizeMm is the nominal square frame edge length in mm (120 or 140). thicknessMm is the frame depth in mm (25 is standard; slim and thick frames noted). maxAirflowCfm is manufacturer-rated maximum airflow in cubic feet per minute at max speed. maxStaticPressureMmH2O is rated maximum static pressure in millimetres of water column (mm-H2O). maxSpeedRpm and minSpeedRpm are the top and bottom of the rated speed range in revolutions per minute (minSpeedRpm null if not specified). maxNoiseDba is rated maximum acoustic noise in A-weighted decibels at max speed. bearingType is an enum: sleeve, rifle, hydraulic, fluid-dynamic, sso2, ball, magnetic-dome, loop-dynamic, or magnetic-levitation. connectorType is an enum: 4-pin-pwm, 3-pin-dc, or proprietary (for daisy-chain ecosystems like Lian Li UNI or Corsair iCUE Link). lighting is an enum: none, argb, or rgb. mtbfHours is rated mean-time-between-failures / lifespan in hours (null if not disclosed). weightGrams is single-fan weight in grams.

The APH Networks NF-A12x25 G2 series review corroborates the SSO2 bearing, 1800 RPM maximum, 63.15 CFM / 3.14 mmH2O ratings and states mean-time-to-failure over 150,000 hours. Both pages explicitly name the exact "NF-A12x25 G2 PWM" 120 mm model and distinguish it from the 140 mm NF-A14x25 G2 and the two-fan Sx2-PP SKU, confirming model identity; Noctua's own site (noctua.at) returned HTTP 429 on every fetch attempt, so these two independent dated reviews reproducing Noctua's published spec sheet were used instead.
